st: Artificial intelligence that paints anything you want

sec.p: Before diving into DALL-E 2's art, the explainer.
Let's see it at work, with the related descriptions.

sec.t: ff.30.3 A few less funny examples
sec.p: A collective (called Hugging Face) recreated the model and opened it to the public. You can play with it, although the resolution is lower, given the hardware limits for training the AI.
Another Twitter user suggested using the software's regression ability (when it's asked, for example, to show the dynamic steps from one image to another) to analyse Picasso's sketches.

sec.t: ff.30.5 The improvements in just one year
sec.p: What's phenomenal about artificial intelligence is the speed of its development. For years people have predicted that the physical (quantum) limits of Moore's Law would halt progress in computing power. The reality is that humans keep inventing loads of ways around them.
